title: Beef Aji Gallina Curry
description: A Peruvian-inspired Indian curry made with shredded beef, aji amarillo peppers, and creamy gallina sauce. This dish combines the bold flavors of Peruvian cuisine with the rich spices of Indian cooking.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onion, garlic, and aji amarillo pepper, and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add curry powder and garam masala, and cook for 1 minute.
Add gallina sauce, coconut milk, and tomato, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the beef is tender.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
